title: Health Charted Profile
description: Identity, conditions, care team, allergies, and goals for the subject. The subject's own non-intervention, non-measurement clinical context. (Medications/supplements live in treatments.json; family history in family-history.json.)

subject.description: The person whose health is being tracked

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth or approximate age

sex.description: Biological sex (relevant for lab ranges and drug metabolism)

user.description: The person using the system (may differ from subject, e.g., parent managing child's health)

relationship_to_subject.description: self, parent, caregiver, provider, or other

name.description: User's name if different from subject

goals.description: What the user wants to accomplish: optimize general health, manage a condition, investigate unexplained symptoms, etc.

conditions.description: Diagnosed or suspected conditions. The canonical home for condition entities (referenced by slug from other files).

slug.description: Stable, immutable kebab-case join key for this condition (e.g., 'iron-deficiency'). Assigned once; never changes. What cross-file references (treatments.treats, etc.) point at. Unique within conditions.

aliases.description: Alternate names that resolve to this condition (reclassifications, lay terms). Merges add an alias; never rewrite the slug.

lifecycle_status.description: Current state of this condition. suspected = noted but not yet investigated; investigating = under workup; active = confirmed and ongoing; managed = stable under intervention; resolved = no longer present.

lifecycle_status_since.description: ISO date the current lifecycle_status began

lifecycle_status_notes.description: Free-text rationale or context for the current status

providers.description: Care team. The canonical home for provider entities (referenced by slug from other files).

slug.description: Stable, immutable kebab-case join key for this provider (e.g., 'jane-okafor-endocrinology'). Disambiguate genuine collisions with a meaningful qualifier. Assigned once; never changes.

insurance.description: Coverage details relevant to care decisions
